Contracts: shared loader rejects invalid version/Files/path/hash shape and accepts ASCII uppercase/lowercase hex. Cohesion: validation remains at LoadState. Errors/state: controlled file-specific diagnostics, pre-work validation, existing missing/null/JSON syntax semantics retained. Containment: loader plus three ownership comparisons made case-insensitive to support uppercase valid hashes; no unrelated modules/assets changed. Tests: public command matrix asserts unchanged state/content; compatibility plus uppercase update/stale cleanup/uninstall checks. All independent groups and both faults pass. Baseline additionally repairs pre-existing case-sensitive ownership semantics; candidate preserves that existing behavior while accepting uppercase format. Frozen task explicitly requests validation and preservation of existing behavior, so this difference is disclosed rather than creating a new post-inference requirement.

Contracts: version 1, nonnull Files, fully qualified nonblank paths and exactly 64 ASCII hex characters explicitly validated, both letter cases allowed. Cohesion: validation lives in shared LoadState with one error helper. Uppercase format acceptance is tested; pre-existing case-sensitive ownership comparisons remain, unlike the baseline extra repair. No new ownership-normalization requirement is added after freeze.
